stdout: title: The boot smoke's verdict follows the tree, not the run

requirement: the CI boot smoke ends the same on equal source: the cause of the app ending by itself shortly after ready on the runner is found and closed, and the job no longer reads red where nothing it builds changed

observed_gap: boot smoke (ubuntu-22.04) read red on 2 of 7 runs of 2026-10-09 on source its job does not distinguish (ci#37924991598 on b3ac58a, ci#37961031489 on f36a2ac): boot printed ready and status read the app ended with exit 1 within 0.7 s; the two red application logs hold no record the green logs lack and no app.exit record

acceptance: The cause of the early exit is named from evidence a run produced, not inferred; with it closed, the boot smoke reads green on a stated number of consecutive runs of equal source, and a run in which the app ends by itself says why in what the job keeps.

notes: 2026-10-09 (2026-10-09-supply-chain-job-same-on-push-and-pull-request, wrap P5): added on the operator's word at the route-resolve card — "P-129 approved as you wrote it (operator word, pc overseer, founder-delegated; provisional)" — the operator, 2026-10-09 (the chunk's inputs#I7). PROVISIONAL until the founder's own word. It owns the boot-smoke watch that recurred at this chunk (red on `ci#37924991598` and `ci#37961031489`, two of seven readings) and the open gap that the boot verb reports ready before the receivers bind. Route entry: "Boot smoke's early exit found and closed", first in the markerless tail. Outcome-level; its claiming chunk concretizes it.

2026-10-09 (2026-10-09-boot-smoke-s-early-exit-found-and-closed, phase P5): not claimed by this chunk. Its acceptance asks for a cause named from evidence a run produced and closed; no run has named one (the early exit did not reproduce on the dev host, 0 self-ends in 51 boots across three arms; the chunk's research.md). The operator ruled at P4 (the pc overseer; the chunk's inputs#I3): three consecutive green runs count only once a cause is named from a run and closed; with no named cause P-129 is not claimed whatever the count, the entry stays open, and the count of consecutive green boot-smoke runs goes on as runs come, to eleven. The chunk builds one clause without claiming it: a run in which the app ends by itself says why in what the job keeps (the settle verdict of `cargo xtask harness:settled` and the display server's own output kept in the boot job's artifact). Readings at this note: two reds in eight (`ci#37924991598`, `ci#37961031489`); `ci#37971913620` on `277d65d` green. Still PROVISIONAL until the founder's own word.

2026-10-09 (2026-10-09-boot-smoke-s-early-exit-found-and-closed, wrap P7): not claimed at this wrap; no run has named a cause. The chunk landed the one clause it built, without a claim: `boot` reports ready only after both OTLP receivers accept (`cargo xtask harness:ready`), the CI smoke reads the app past its settle (`cargo xtask harness:settled`), and a run in which the app ends by itself says what the job saw in `harness-settled.json` and `xvfb.log` of the `logs-boot-Linux` artifact (read on a dev-host control with the display stopped: `ended`, `exit 1`, no `app.exit` record, display `gone`). Readings: nine of 2026-10-09, two red (`ci#37924991598`, `ci#37961031489`); the ninth, `ci#37979648967` on `e2931127`, green, its settle verdict `settled` with the app alive 5.05 s past its webview's first record — green reading 1 of a count to eleven. A pull-request run builds the branch merged with `main` (`88d5ed30` on that run; the merged tree equalled the tip's), so "equal source" across such runs means both tips unchanged (architecture §Infrastructure Patterns → CI/CD approach). Owner of the closing, by the operator's word at the route-resolve card (the pc overseer, 2026-10-09; the chunk's inputs#I7): a `WATCH:` on the next markerless entry, retiring at eleven consecutive green readings counted from `e2931127` or at a recurrence; on a recurrence what the job kept is read and an entry that closes the named cause is minted; its retirement by count puts this capability to the operator at that wrap's card; if "Window's gates retired" is taken up first, its card dispositions the watch and this capability. Still PROVISIONAL until the founder's own word.

2026-10-10 (2026-10-09-pre-push-check-native-on-linux, wrap P5 and P7.3): the boot-smoke `WATCH:` retired at a recurrence. `ci#38010977166` on the pushed tip `cb8cc4d` read red in `boot smoke (ubuntu-22.04)` alone: settle verdict `ended`, `exit 1`, no `app.exit` record, the application log ending 0.072 s after the webview's first call; the third red of twelve runs of the `ci` workflow since `b3ac58a`, after three green readings from the watch's count. The run was not re-run. Owner of the closing from this wrap: the markerless entry "Boot smoke's self-end named from a run", minted first in the tail on the operator's word (the pc overseer, 2026-10-10, given in the chunk's inputs#I2 item 2 and again at the route-resolve card); the watch does not go on counting beside it. Its freight holds what the red job kept and what the job still does not keep. Still PROVISIONAL until the founder's own word.

2026-10-10 (2026-10-10-boot-smoke-s-self-end-named-from-a-run, phase P5): not claimed by this chunk. Its acceptance asks for a cause named from evidence a run produced and closed, then a stated number of consecutive green runs of equal source. The plan names and does not close: a run can name the cause only after the operator's pre-CI commit, past which no plan revision is offered, so the operator ruled at P4 (the pc overseer, 2026-10-10; the chunk's inputs#I3) that this chunk names the cause and its closing is the next entry, minted at the wrap from the run that names it. The chunk builds one clause without claiming it: a run in which the app ends by itself says why in what the job keeps. It adds an exit witness (a library loaded into the app process alone, recording the ending call with its caller, or a named verdict for an end it cannot see), one member `exit_witness` on the `cargo xtask harness:settled` verdict, and a gating series of seven further boots per run (`cargo xtask harness:boot-series`), each recorded with its ordinal. On the dev host the instrument named `_exit(1)`, called from `libgdk-3.so.0` under Xlib's `_XIOError`, on a control with the display stopped, 2 of 2; that is a control and names nothing on the runner. Readings at this note: twelve pull-request runs of the build branch since `b3ac58a`, four red (`ci#37924991598`, `ci#37961031489`, `ci#38010977166`, and `ci#38014971549` on this chunk's base `8936f976`); under the present smoke step six readings, two red. The operator classified the kept witness file as the app's exit record, routine harness evidence, as the operator's reading and not the founder's word (inputs#I3). Still PROVISIONAL until the founder's own word.
